ref rItem
float fRes
Begin Function { }
let rPlayer := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "14"
let rDoc := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "104C0F"
let rObj := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "3A"
let rOther := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "38"
let fRes := -1
if (GetGlobalValue rObj) == 30
  let fRes := GetGlobalValue rOther
  rPlayer.AuxVarSetFlt "*nvfGH" fRes
  if fRes < 22
    SetGameHour (fRes + 1)
  endif
endif
SetFunctionValue (fRes >= 0)
End
steps.label: gamehour.set
